# S5.3 — Analysis engine C2 depth: fit_surface, strata, hosted lifecycles (§6.4, §6.5, §6.6)

**Stacked on:** `svitali/harnessharness-s5.2` (PR #84) · **Do not merge — operator-controlled**

## Summary

Lands the comparison & analysis engine's C2 depth — A7
`fit_surface` with `factorial_glmm` /
`curve_on_ordered_axis`, expiry wiring and the `refit`
removal-test kind, A14 strata views over the five axes,
judged realized-benefit stages, A10 designed-ablation →
`attribution_report/1`, the classified-diff retirement
gate, publication `verifiable_by` and the `reproduced`
public tier, and the hosted interception (Adapter B) and
container-installed (Adapter C) lifecycles with hosted
bundle export — under the `offline-only` budget
(`R-2.10.4`, `R-2.10.1`, `R-2.10.2`, `R-2.10.3`,
`R-2.10.5`, `R-2.10.6` — C2 slices).

**`fit_surface` C2** (`hh-analysis`; R-2.10.4): the A7
surface gains `model_form ∈ {contrast, factorial_glmm,
curve_on_ordered_axis}` — `factorial_glmm` reports fixed
effects + shrinkage; `curve_on_ordered_axis` fits a
monotone trend by pooled-adjacent-violators. One
`MatchSpec` governs a surface — joined rows under
differing matching disciplines refuse
`IncommensurableMatchSpec`. A design below the form's
minimum reports `insufficient` with the deficit named,
and unobserved cells are typed `unknown{reason}` — never
zeroed. `SurfaceExpiry` wires `fitted_at`/`now`/`max_age`
to a report `status ∈ {active, expiring, expired}` and
mints an `AssumptionDebtRecord` carrying
`RemovalTestKind::Refit` (`refit{min_design}` — the
re-fit re-runs the declared design template; ontology +
HIR validation landed). Hosted coordinates are honest: a
component-level axis is native-only (hosted runs listed
`n/a{class}`, never fitted); a hosted row on a
configuration-level axis joins only where its
conditionality admits the coordinate; disagreeing hosted
rows produce `unknown{hosted_rows_disagree}` — never
averaged, never coerced.

**A14 `strata_view`** (R-2.10.4 §2.5): per-stratum tables
over `contamination_stratum`, `capability_vector`,
`cost_confidence`, `suite_validity` and `mediation` —
hosted strata key by capability vector / mediation / cost
confidence per §2.5. `filters.aggregate = pooled` refuses
`StrataPooledUnannotated` — the same refusal name
`hh_eval::scorecard` raises (ADR-0012 D6).

**Judged realized-benefit stages** (§2.3):
`realized_stages` emits `hh-realized-stages/1` joining the
deterministic headline with the judged
`activated`/`followed` detector observations — a judged
leg the host cannot see stays `n/a{class}`, never a zero.

**A10 attribution** (KA-10): the `designed_ablation`
result lands as a first-class `attribution_report/1`
section carrying the M1 members; hosted attribution
limitations stay named in the report.

**Retirement classified-diff gate** (R-2.10.3;
AC-R-2.10.3-13): `hh-lab`'s retirement context now carries
a `RetirementDiffResolver` producing
`RetirementDiffView{authority_delta, budget_delta,
semantic_ops, candidate_bound}`; a classified diff that is
not a single-rule removal is refused (typed `Refused`,
never a warning) unless `candidate_bound` — wired through
Lab → `hh-experiment` → `hh-embed`.

**Publication** (R-2.10.5): `PublishedLeaderboard` carries
`verifiable_by[reader → level]` — a reader whose cut
withholds payload (`restricted_store`, or `content`
omitted from `content_classes`) sees a digest-only index →
`R0`; else the admitted entries' minimum resolved
`claimed_level`. `LeaderboardDefinition::public()` admits
only `reproduced`-covering bundles (ADR-0140's independent
reproduction); `PublicationPolicy::public()` is the
matching per-suite default — every withheld member lands
in the loss report, never silently dropped (CC3).

**Hosted lifecycles** (R-2.10.6; §6.6 §5): **Adapter B**
(`hh.adapter.b`) — model-boundary interception for
hook-bearing CLIs without a session protocol: proxy
`model_io` lifts `mediated`; participant hooks lift
`observed`; a hook-reported call the proxy did not
intercept reconstructs from transcript rows `unobserved`;
`set_coordinate{model}` lands on the proxy's upstream;
`GenParamPolicy{forward[], default{}}` is a declared
adapter parameter (debt record on the `AdapterRecord`) —
unlisted parameters are stripped and logged, never
silently applied. **Adapter C** (`hh.adapter.c`) —
container-installed participants: `install`/`run`/`kill`/
`snapshot` lifecycle lifting, and
`close_and_reconstruct` synthesizes an honest
`reconstructed` terminal when the container emitted none.

**Hosted bundle export**: hosted assembly gains
`adapter_version` and `descriptor_version` claims (from
the bound-component and attach rows, `environment`
authority) and a `hosted_native_records` member carrying
the raw `lifecycle.hosted.native_record` leaves —
classified `content`, so a withholding policy lists them
in the loss report rather than dropping them.
